requirements.statement: A user signs in to the application so that their uploads are kept private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is prompted to sign in before reaching the upload or gallery views
After signing in, the user reaches the application as themselves

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can upload an image so that it is stored and available to view later

criteria.must: A signed-in user can select an image file and submit it for upload
After a successful upload, the image is stored and persists across sessions
The uploaded image is associated only with the user who uploaded it

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can see a gallery of all images they have previously uploaded

criteria.must: The gallery lists every image the signed-in user has previously uploaded
The gallery does not list images uploaded by a different user

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can view an individual uploaded image at full size

criteria.must: Selecting an image from the gallery opens a full-size view of that image
The full-size view shows more detail than the gallery thumbnail

requirements.statement: Uploaded images are private per user, with no sharing or cross-user visibility

criteria.must: A user cannot access another user's uploaded image via its gallery or detail view
